text:
Martin Necas has 23 points in 18 games, and the shape of them is worth a look. Nine goals have come on 5.2 expected goals (the quality of his chances), and he is shooting 24% against 18% last season. That finishing rarely holds. The creating does: Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him at 10.4 primary shot assists per 60 last season, 95th percentile among forwards, and he carries the puck in on 62% of his entries.

So the assists are the part to trust. Evolving-Hockey had him 11th of 401 forwards in wins above replacement in 2025-26, with the caveat that he plays beside elite teammates, which flatters raw on-ice numbers. He had four points against Detroit on Nov. 7, and Yahoo Sports has him climbing the franchise record books.

Off the ice, Sportskeeda reports he was among the Czech NHL players who condemned a minister's comments about women's hockey. On it, expect the goals to slow and the points to keep coming: our range has him finishing between 81 and 109.
headline: Necas is scoring like a sniper. Mostly he isn't one
